description:
Move the last `repository_state` references out of the domain layer and route the remaining hand-written type-label filter through the shared extractor, closing the story checkpoint of `one-form-convergence`.

## Background

- `crates/jit/src/domain/relative_path.rs` has a test module that imports `crate::repository_state::RepositoryLayoutError` for `test_rejected_parse_converts_to_lexical_escape_with_the_input_text`. That test checks `impl From<RootRelativePathError> for RepositoryLayoutError`, which lives in `crates/jit/src/repository_state/path.rs`.
- The `RootRelativePath` rustdoc in the same file links `crate::repository_state::VirtualPath`, so the domain type documents an outer-layer consumer.
- Four test sites read type labels by hand instead of through the extractors in `crates/jit/src/labels.rs` (`is_type_label`, `type_label_value`, `type_label_values`): the declared `--type` update test in `crates/jit/src/commands/issue.rs`, two tests in `crates/jit/tests/cli_issue/issue_create_positional_type_tests.rs`, and one in `crates/jit/tests/fast_docs_templates/template_binding_tests.rs`.
- Epic criteria: `b697a3f7` REQ-18 (domain imports nothing from `repository_state`) and REQ-20 (type extraction from labels has one normalisation).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: No file under `crates/jit/src/domain/` names `repository_state`, in code, tests or rustdoc.
- [hard] REQ-02: The conversion test asserts the same property from `crates/jit/src/repository_state/path.rs`, beside the `From` impl it covers.
- [hard] REQ-03: No code under `crates/` outside `labels.rs` tests for or strips the `type:` prefix by hand; each of the four sites uses the shared extractor.
title: Domain names nothing from repository_state and type labels have no hand-written filter
